stats_document_title.description: Browser tab title of the statistics page. Focus Lock is the product name and stays untranslated.

stats_page_title.description: Main heading at the top of the statistics page.

stats_loading.description: Quiet line shown while the statistics page waits for its data.

stats_load_error.message: Could not load stats. Reload to try again.
stats_load_error.description: Error line replacing the whole statistics page when its data cannot be read.

stats_partial_error_both.message: Hourly attempts and site access credit settings are unavailable.
stats_partial_error_both.description: Warning above the panels when both the hourly attempt log and the site access credit settings failed to load.

stats_partial_error_attempts.description: Warning above the panels when only the hourly attempt log failed to load.

stats_partial_error_economy.message: Site access credit settings are unavailable.
stats_partial_error_economy.description: Warning above the panels when only the site access credit settings failed to load.

stats_scope_synced.message: Synced totals from this Chrome account. Local-only panels are labeled.
stats_scope_synced.description: Line under the page heading when the totals come from Chrome account sync.

stats_scope_local.message: Totals from this machine. Focus Lock statistics are not synced.
stats_scope_local.description: Line under the page heading when the totals come from this computer only. Focus Lock is the product name.

stats_scope_checking.message: Checking whether these totals are synced.
stats_scope_checking.description: Line under the page heading while the page is still finding out where its totals come from.

stats_scope_unavailable.message: Statistics scope is unavailable. Totals may include synced data. Hourly attempts and recent sessions are from this machine.
stats_scope_unavailable.description: Line under the page heading when the page cannot find out whether its totals are synced.

stats_scope_retry.description: Button next to the heading line that asks again where the totals come from.

stats_empty.message: Stats appear after your first session.
stats_empty.description: Quiet first-run line replacing the row of summary tiles when nothing has been recorded yet.

stats_tile_focus_today.description: Label of the summary tile holding today's focused time.

stats_tile_focus_last_7_days.description: Label of the summary tile holding focused time over the last seven days.

stats_tile_attempts_today.description: Label of the summary tile counting today's blocked visits to distracting sites.

stats_tile_gate_dismissed_today.description: Label of the summary tile counting the times the user opened the unlock gate today and then walked away from it.

stats_tile_credit_spent_today.description: Label of the summary tile holding the earned browsing time spent today.

stats_tile_credit_subline_spent.description: Breakdown under the site access credit tile on a day with spending. All three values are durations such as 5 m or 1 h 05 m. ALL_SITES is credit spent on a pause that unblocks everything, ONE_SITE credit spent to unblock a single site, EARNED the credit earned that day.

stats_tile_credit_subline_earned.description: Breakdown under the site access credit tile on a day with no spending. EARNED is a duration such as 17 m.

stats_streak_heading.description: Heading of the panel showing consecutive focus days.

stats_streak_empty.message: Your streak starts with your first focus day.
stats_streak_empty.description: Quiet first-run line inside the streak panel when no focus day has been recorded yet.

stats_streak_unit_one.description: Unit next to the streak number, singular. The number itself is rendered separately.

stats_streak_unit_other.description: Unit next to the streak number, plural. The number itself is rendered separately.

stats_streak_freeze_tokens_one.description: Screen reader name of the row of freeze chips, singular. A freeze token covers one missed day without breaking the streak. COUNT is how many are banked.

stats_streak_freeze_tokens_other.description: Screen reader name of the row of freeze chips, plural. A freeze token covers one missed day without breaking the streak. COUNT is how many are banked.

stats_streak_freeze_chip_title.message: Streak freeze: one missed day, covered
stats_streak_freeze_chip_title.description: Hover text of a single freeze chip, explaining what one banked token buys.

stats_streak_active_days_one.description: Caption above the streak calendar, singular. COUNT is how many days of this month had a focus session, MONTH the month and year in the reader's locale.

stats_streak_active_days_other.description: Caption above the streak calendar, plural. COUNT is how many days of this month had a focus session, MONTH the month and year in the reader's locale.

stats_streak_active_dates.description: Screen reader name of the streak calendar grid. MONTH is the month and year, DAYS the day numbers of that month that had a focus session, already joined with commas.

stats_streak_no_active_dates.description: Screen reader name of the streak calendar grid when the month has no focus day yet. MONTH is the month and year.

stats_chart_focus_heading.description: Heading and accessible name of the daily focus time bar chart.

stats_chart_focus_empty.message: Focus minutes appear after your first session.
stats_chart_focus_empty.description: Quiet first-run line replacing the daily focus time chart when there is nothing to plot.

stats_chart_attempts_heading.description: Heading and accessible name of the daily blocked attempts bar chart.

stats_chart_attempts_empty.message: Blocked attempts show up here once a session catches one.
stats_chart_attempts_empty.description: Quiet first-run line replacing the daily blocked attempts chart when there is nothing to plot.

stats_chart_sites_heading.description: Heading and accessible name of the chart ranking the most blocked websites.

stats_chart_sites_empty.message: Nothing blocked yet. That is a fine start.
stats_chart_sites_empty.description: Quiet first-run line replacing the top blocked sites chart when nothing has been blocked.

stats_chart_hours_heading.message: Attempts by hour, this machine only
stats_chart_hours_heading.description: Heading of the panel showing blocked attempts by hour of the day.

stats_chart_other_site.description: Row label of the top blocked sites chart gathering every site outside the top ten.

stats_chart_minutes_tick.description: Axis tick of the focus chart, minutes abbreviated to a single letter to fit the axis. MINUTES is the number.

stats_blocked_count_one.description: Value read out for one bar or table row of a blocked attempts chart, singular. COUNT is how many attempts were blocked.

stats_blocked_count_other.description: Value read out for one bar or table row of a blocked attempts chart, plural. COUNT is how many attempts were blocked.

stats_chart_name_bar.description: Fallback accessible name of a vertical bar chart that was given no name of its own.

stats_chart_name_hbar.description: Fallback accessible name of a horizontal bar chart that was given no name of its own.

stats_chart_description_bar.message: Bar chart. Use the keyboard to move through data points, or open View as table for the same values.
stats_chart_description_bar.description: Screen reader description of a vertical bar chart. View as table is the label of the disclosure below the chart, so keep both spellings the same.

stats_chart_description_hbar.message: Horizontal bar chart. Use the keyboard to move through data points, or open View as table for the same values.
stats_chart_description_hbar.description: Screen reader description of a horizontal bar chart. View as table is the label of the disclosure below the chart, so keep both spellings the same.

stats_chart_empty_default.description: Fallback quiet line replacing a chart that was given no first-run line of its own.

stats_chart_point.description: Screen reader name of one data point. LABEL is the category, such as a date or a website, and VALUE the already formatted measurement.

stats_chart_table_summary.description: Label of the disclosure under each chart that opens the same values as a table.

stats_chart_table_category.description: First column header of the table under a chart, holding the date, hour, or website of each row.

stats_chart_table_value.description: Second column header of the table under a chart, holding the measurement of each row.

stats_heat_strip_label.description: Screen reader name of the strip of 24 cells whose shading shows how many attempts each hour of the day blocked.

stats_sessions_heading.description: Heading of the panel listing the most recent focus sessions.

stats_sessions_empty.message: Your first session will appear here.
stats_sessions_empty.description: Quiet first-run line inside the recent sessions panel when no session has been recorded yet.

stats_sessions_col_date.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: the day the session started.

stats_sessions_col_start.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: the time of day the session started.

stats_sessions_col_planned.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: the length the session was started for.

stats_sessions_col_focused.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: the time actually spent focused.

stats_sessions_col_all_sites.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: credit spent on pauses that unblocked every site.

stats_sessions_col_one_site.description: Session table column header, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: credit spent unblocking a single site.

stats_sessions_col_intention.description: Session table column header: the note the user wrote about what the session was for.

stats_sessions_col_outcome.description: Session table column header: how the session finished.

stats_sessions_col_source.description: Session table column header, hidden from sight and read only by screen readers, and the same field label on the narrow-screen card: whether the session was started by hand or by a schedule.

stats_session_no_intention.description: Stands in for the intention of a session the user started without writing one.

stats_session_article_label.description: Screen reader name of one session card on a narrow screen. INTENTION is the note the user wrote, or the stand-in for a session started without one.

stats_session_source_manual.description: Says a session was started by hand. Shown on the narrow-screen card and read out for the dot glyph in the table. Lower case, because it sits inside a row rather than opening a sentence.

stats_session_source_schedule.description: Says a session was started by a schedule. Shown on the narrow-screen card. Lower case, because it sits inside a row rather than opening a sentence.

stats_session_source_scheduled.description: Read out for the clock glyph in the session table, saying the session was started by a schedule. Lower case, because it sits inside a row rather than opening a sentence.

stats_outcome_completed.description: Outcome of a session that ran to its end, recorded before the extension stored a reason for it.

stats_outcome_ended_early.description: Outcome of a session that stopped before its planned end, including one the extension never saw finish.

stats_outcome_running.description: Outcome of the session that is still going right now.
